## Math

Posts can contain LaTeX. For example, the mean squared error is

$$
\text{MSE} = \frac{1}{n}\sum_{i=1}^{n} \left(y_i - \hat{y}_i\right)^2 .
$$

## Code and plots

Code runs when the post is rendered on my machine, and the result is saved
("frozen") so GitHub only needs to publish it.

```{python}
#| label: fig-sine
#| fig-cap: "A noisy sine wave with a fitted curve."
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

rng = np.random.default_rng(0)
x = np.linspace(0, 2 * np.pi, 60)
y = np.sin(x) + rng.normal(0, 0.2, x.size)
coef = np.polyfit(x, y, 5)

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(7, 4))
ax.scatter(x, y, color="#9ca3af", label="data")
ax.plot(x, np.polyval(coef, x), color="#06436e", lw=3, label="degree-5 fit")
ax.legend(); ax.spines[["top", "right"]].set_visible(False)
fig.savefig("thumbnail.png", dpi=100, bbox_inches="tight")
plt.show()
```
